publicInputVerification.method: Independent Node crypto verified every retained manifest digest/seal with the separately captured operator PEM, matched all sealed member hashes and archive/PEM bytes. No application modules were imported by this audit.

rootCause.finding: admittedInboxName chooses the currently preferred peerId, otherwise a key-derived bucket. refuseReplayOrRollback scans only that bucket. Creating a peer for a previously list-admitted key, or a lexically earlier alias for an existing peer key, loses sight of same-publisher history.
rootCause.actualEffects: Both transitions accept an exact replay and an older distinct-ID package into peer-a. Returned paths and changed recipient name/content/history/link/inode snapshots are persisted for all four cases.
